title: Grateful Dead Live at Cameron Indoor Stadium, Duke U on 1982-04-02
source: NAK deck > 2 90 minute UDXL II cassette masters, REC from centered seats behind the stage. Tascam 322 > Marantz CDR 510 > CDR > EAC > WAV > CD WAV Editor > Flac 8

ai_review.summary: A newly identified audience recording that sounds surprisingly good, capturing a show fans love.
ai_review.review: The tape is an unknown floor‑audience source that many reviewers say sounds better than their own masters, with typical crowd chatter and occasional “Waahoo” shouts. While no specific songs are highlighted, listeners express clear affection for the performance overall.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave 4‑star ratings and praised the show; recording is described as a good new audience source despite unknown taper, leading to an overall solid rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Floor audience tape with crowd chatter and occasional loud yell (“Waahoo”). Unknown taper; considered a new source that sounds better than the reviewer’s own masters.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure or pacing.
